text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is that cardboard box?
choice_data_list: There's a letter for No Reason in here

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho, it was a letter from a fan!
Let me read it at once!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The love from you all...
I've received it loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm in high spirits~!
Let us write a reply at once!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "I trust you have been doing reasonably well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason took up a brush and began writing out
what looked like masterfully penned hentaigana calligraphy.
choice_data_list: I can't read hentaigana written in such beautiful calligraphy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
I assumed everyone engaged in this to some extent.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then it cannot be helped.
I shall write using the kind of characters everyone else uses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason seemed a bit unaccustomed to it,
but she began writing with standard characters carefully.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright! It is finished!
How is it? Surely you can read it now!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if those who support me
will be delighted by this letter...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
They wrote to me with such heartfelt passion,
yet here I am, showing them a false version of myself...
choice_data_list: You might be right about that...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Right...? Was it truly wise of me
to pen a missive using unfamiliar script...?
choice_data_list: Let's write it however No Reason wants to!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't that make it impossible to read—
choice_data_list: It's fine! I'll add the translation!
It's fine! I'll add the translation!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see, a brilliant idea!
Let's go with that!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now, I'm counting on you to translate!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"You can't even read this?!
What a hopeless fellow!"
choice_data_list: I'm telling you, nobody would normally be able to read that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having finished writing her reply,
No Reason threw herself into her training with even greater zeal than usual.
